# pnpm

This mod adds PNPM to linuxserver/code-server and linuxserver/openvscode-server, to be installed during container start.

Add it to the `code-server` container with the environment variable

```
DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:code-server-pnpm
```

Several mods are separated by `|`, for example
`DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:code-server-pnpm|ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:universal-tshoot`. Recreate the container to
apply the change.

The mod's page on the website: https://linuxserver-playground.github.io/site/mods/code-server-pnpm/
